premises.text: Screen-based navigation makes OR teams look away from the patient, so surgeons avoid using it
premises.evidence_span: Not a single person in the OR is actually looking at the patient during the procedure because all the navigated information is projected on a distant screen

premises.text: A see-through visor projects a registered 3D anatomy model onto both retinas with depth perception and tracks tools inside the anatomy
premises.evidence_span: a see-through device that goes beyond the limitation of our eyes and beyond the complications of any other existing technology

premises.text: Registration workflow (marker, scan, 3D CT model) matches other navigation systems to ease adoption
premises.evidence_span: We place a marker on the patient, and then we scan the patient just before the surgery

premises.text: Visor is sold by integrating into partners' existing surgical navigation and imaging systems
premises.evidence_span: we already signed strategic partnership with several global leaders that will eventually sell our system together with their system
